انتهجوا (form VII)
# اِنْتَهَجُوا (intahajū) /in.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اُنْتُهِجُوا (untuhijū) /un.tu.hi.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اِنْتَهِجُوا (intahijū) /in.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
